newsitem.title: CHINA: China forex market volume rises in first half '97.
newsitem.headline: China forex market volume rises in first half '97.

text.p: Daily turnover on China's national foreign exchange market hit $257 million in the first half of this year, up eight percent year-on-year, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
Total turnover for the Shanghai-based market, which trades just three currencies, hit $31.88 billion for the 124 business days in the first half, the newspaper said.
It gave no comparitive figures for 1996.
U.S. dollar turnover was $29.37 billion in the first half, Hong Kong dollar turnover was HK$16.22 billion and Japanese yen turnover 49.74 billion, the newspaper said.
The weighted average rate of the Chinese currency was 8.2907 yuan versus U.S. $1 by the end of first half, compared with 8.2984 yuan at the end of last year, the newspaper said.
